name: duckdb-component-web
description: Boot the DuckLink core wasip2 component in the browser via @tegmentum/wasi-polyfill; JS bindings generated by wit-js-bindgen from wit/core/wit

scripts.copy-wasm: cp ../../duckdb-wasm/target/wasm32-wasip2/release/ducklink_core.wasm public/ && cp ../artifacts/extensions/sample_extension.wasm public/ && cp ../artifacts/extensions/cron.wasm public/ && cp ../artifacts/extensions/cron_scheduler.wasm public/
scripts.verify-tvm-aot: npm run copy-wasm && jco transpile public/ducklink_core.wasm -o .tvm-aot --instantiation async --no-nodejs-compat && AOT_DIR=.tvm-aot node aot-tvm-test.mjs
